utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m putting together the repair drive invites now — want me to add you to the list?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please add me — I’ll help with the tools list and catch up once I get there a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you on the repair drive list, and thanks for helping with the tools. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. Let’s sort the broken things first, then match each repair to a person.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good—I'm still catching up, but I can help keep things organized. Just send me the latest list and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Nell. Once you have the latest list, send it my way and I’ll help line up who does what first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can still make it if we keep it early, right after school drop-off. Just let me know the time and I’ll plan around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — I’m just waiting on the exact time and drop-off spot before I head over. Can you confirm those for me?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I don’t have the exact time or drop-off spot yet, but I’ll send them as soon as I get them. If it stays early, I can still make it work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I may have missed an update, so I’m counting on you to keep me posted on whether we’re gathering donations or already fixing things.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still gathering donations for now, and I’m keeping track of what we have. I’ll let you know right away if we still need anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — that helps. I’ll stay tuned and let you know if I hear anything useful, too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Early afternoon works for me too — just text me before you head over so I can make sure I’m ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the repair drive details around the block, and I’ll text you before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that sounds helpful. Just give me a little notice before you come by so I can be ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good — if you’re thinking of heading over, I’d go soon before the best tools get sorted. I’ll keep an ear out for the next workday and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I’m still checking whether the repair drive has actually started or if we’re just gathering donations. I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Hana — thanks for checking. I’ll keep listening around and pass along anything I hear about whether they’ve started or just got the donations going.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive start yet, or are we still gathering donations?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Not yet — I’m still sorting the broken-things list and matching folks to each repair. Once that’s set, I’ll check the tools and pick a good time to start.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — thanks, Oren. Let me know when the list is set, and I’ll check whether we still need anything before we start.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — just point me to the spot and I’ll head over if repairs are underway.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo — it’s for this Saturday, and I’ll point you to the right spot once we’re underway.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — just let me know where to go when it starts, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll head to the community center on Sunday. Let me know the exact drop-off details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Opal — I’ll send the exact drop-off details as soon as I have them. For now, we’re still gathering tools, spare parts, and volunteer hands for Saturday’s repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — I’ll keep Sunday at the community center in mind. Let me know if you need me to track any drop-off details or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: After 4 is still best — I’ll bring it to the usual drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — small correction: the drop-off is now Sunday at the community center, not the usual spot. I’m still confirming the exact details and will send them over soon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — Sunday at the community center works. Send the final details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. If you can grab the tools list, I can keep my part simple.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll bring the tools list and keep it simple for you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I’ll keep things simple on my end and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’m still good for after 4 — I’ll swing by and help sort things out. Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — after 4 works great, and I’ll have the tools ready if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, Gus — I’ll swing by after 4 and lend a hand. Just keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely—if you need any tools for the repair drive, just let me know and I’ll bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Gus — I’ll keep spreading the repair drive details around the block and let folks know where to go. If I hear what tools are needed, I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Vik—thanks for spreading the word. Just send me the tool list when you get it, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I can bring the screws and duct tape after 4, and I’ll message you before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — I’ll confirm the repair-drive status and let you know if we’re still gathering donations or ready to start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana — just let me know if you still need anything else, and I’ll bring it after 4.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: After 4 at the usual drop-off spot works for me. I’ll bring the list and we can sort the rest there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works for me, Leo — after 4 at the usual drop-off spot. I’ll be there with the repair-drive list so we can sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, see you after 4 at the usual spot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll handle the squeaky doors and that leaky faucet first. Just point me to where to start.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll catch up when I get there a bit late and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries — I’ll get started and keep an ear out for updates. See you when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re still confirming the exact status, but for now we’re gathering tools, spare parts, and volunteer hands for Saturday. If you can help, I’ll send you Mara’s way for coordination.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the exact spot for Saturday, too? I just want to make sure I go to the right place after 4.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still checking the exact spot with Hana and Mara, but I’ll send it over as soon as I confirm. After 4 is fine — I’ll keep you posted right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just send me the urgent repairs and the time window, and I’ll head over if they’re underway.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Head to the community center on Maple by the side entrance, and send me the urgent repairs plus the time window.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll send the urgent repairs and time window as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as they pick the next workday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate you keeping me posted. I’m still catching up, so any details you hear would really help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll pass along anything I hear right away, especially the next workday and what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Ira — has the repair drive started yet, or are we still gathering donations?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re still gathering donations for now — I just ran a few errands, so I can swing by and help if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira — that helps. I’ll keep gathering donations for now, and I’ll let you know if we need you to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Oren — I can add you to the repair drive invite list and keep you posted on any updates.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still lining up the repair list and matching folks to each job. Once that’s sorted, I’ll send the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — thanks, Oren. I’ll keep an eye out for the time and place, and I’ll pass it along as soon as you send it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep it simple and send the confirmed drop-off details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll keep my part simple and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I’ve got it handled, and I’ll send the confirmed details as soon as they’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 8:30 at the mailbox works for me — thanks, Eli. I’ll plan around school pickup and be there early.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that gives us a clear start. We’ll sort the broken things first, then match each repair to the right person.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 8:30 by the mailbox and we can start with the broken items first.
